questions.q: An array Names holds ['Ann', 'Ben', 'Cy', 'Dev']. What does Names[3] give?
questions.why: Indices start at 0, so index 3 is the fourth item, 'Dev'.

questions.q: Which data structure is best for storing a student's name (string), age (integer) and form (string) together?
questions.why: A record has named fields that can hold different data types.

questions.q: A file is opened in Python with mode "w". What happens to existing contents?
options: They are kept and new data is added
They are read into a list
questions.why: Write mode creates the file or erases what was there; append mode ("a") keeps it.

questions.q: In a 2D array Marks, state what Marks[2,5] refers to.
questions.model: The item in row 2, column 5 (the third row and sixth column, because indices start at 0).
